# h3_vm_images (Data Source)

OS images available for new VMs. The catalog is served by h3vm (`GET /api/vms/v1/images`); only images that are offered and present in the cluster are listed. Use `id` as the `image` of `h3_vm`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Supported Ubuntu images, newest first.
data "h3_vm_images" "ubuntu" {
  family = "ubuntu"
  status = "supported"
}

output "latest_ubuntu" {
  value = data.h3_vm_images.ubuntu.images[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `family` (String) Filter: family id, e.g. `ubuntu`.
- `lang` (String) Language of `name`/`family_name`: `ru` (default) or `en`.
- `os_type` (String) Filter: `linux` or `windows`.
- `status` (String) Filter: `supported` or `deprecated`.
- `usage` (String) Where the image is used: `vm` (default) or `capsule`.

### Read-Only

- `default` (String) Default image id.
- `id` (String) Catalog revision (same as `revision`).
- `images` (Attributes List) Images in catalog order (families, then versions; newest first). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))
- `revision` (String) Catalog revision.

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `eol` (String) End of upstream support, `YYYY-MM-DD` (empty if unknown).
- `family` (String) Family id.
- `family_name` (String) Family display name.
- `id` (String) Image id, the `image` of `h3_vm` (e.g. `ubuntu:24.04`).
- `min_cpu` (Number) Minimum vCPU.
- `min_disk_gi` (Number) Minimum root disk, GiB.
- `min_memory_gi` (Number) Minimum memory, GiB.
- `name` (String) Version display name.
- `os_type` (String) `linux` or `windows`.
- `status` (String) `supported` or `deprecated`.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags, e.g. `lts`, `evaluation`, `preview`.
- `usage` (List of String) Where offered: `vm`, `capsule`.
- `version` (String) Version, e.g. `24.04`.
